macros.name: cropboxsep
macros.doc: The \cropboxsep{⟨length⟩} command specifies the separation value to be used in calculation of crop-box dimensions when any of optional parameters is omitted or empty.

macros.name: croplinelength
macros.doc: The \croplinelength{⟨length⟩} command specifies a length and direction of crop-lines: the absolute value of ⟨length⟩ specifies a length of crop-lines and the sign of ⟨length⟩ specifies a direction.

macros.name: croplinewidth
macros.doc: The \croplinewidth{⟨length⟩} command specifies a width of crop-lines.
